text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I arrive at the summer training site 
together with Special Week. Once 
we get 
there, however...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Blegh... I-it's so hot...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know I need to do this... in order to win... 
But it's just way too hot...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The heat is getting to her head. I need to 
figure out how to cheer her 
up...
choice_data_list: Let's eat good festival food tonight.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Delicious... festival food?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
They... they have baked potatoes with 
butter, right?! It's a festival 
staple!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! I think I'm ready to start training! 
Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Special Week all fired up and ready 
to go, she blasts through 
her entire 
training regimen. Afterwards...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! There are so many different 
stalls... So many people too. I 
don't think 
I've ever been to such a packed festival.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Where do we even begin?! Oh, I see a 
baked potato stall! Let's start 
with that!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was delicious! Baked potatoes 
with butter never 
disappoint, no matter 
the festival!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So where do we go next? That 
Umamusume sponge cake over there
 
looks—oh!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass and the others are here too! Do you 
mind if I say hi to them 
really quickly?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Thud!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oops! I'm sorry! I didn't mean to 
bump—oof! So many people!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week gets caught in the crowd, 
unable to move due to the 
sheer density 
of people on the streets.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I lead Special Week down a path that isn't 
so packed.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew! W-we made it! Thanks for saving me 
back there, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I will! 
Hey, Grass! Over heeere!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I wait for Special Week to finish her 
business, I decide to buy 
some 
Umamusume sponge cake to try out.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
See ya!
...Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wait a second... Sniff... sniff... I smell something sweet. That bag... Is it what I think it is?
choice_data_list: That's the one you wanted to eat.
That's the one you wanted to eat.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! It's the Umamusume sponge cake!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You got it for me, didn't you?! Oh, you 
really shouldn't have!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanna get you something too! What to 
get, what to get... Hm? That 
stall over 
there...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I know just what to give you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week hands me her gift, and we 
head to the beach to enjoy 
each other's 
treats.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmmm... That sponge cake was so good! It 
took only three seconds 
to make it 
disappear!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Adding "Umamusume" to things 
makes them taste different 
somehow! They 
didn't do stuff like this back home, that's 
for sure.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
How about yours? Your shaved ice was 
made using milk from 
Hokkaido!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's good! Oh, take your time though. If 
you eat too much at once, 
you'll get brain 
freeze.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I want you savor the taste of my 
hometown!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Come to think of it, why is festival 
food so good?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I mean... Take yakisoba or baked 
potatoes, for example. They're 
super 
simple everyday foods! Yet they still 
somehow taste absolutely 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My mom always wondered why too. But... I 
think I've figured out the 
reason why it 
tastes the way it does.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Festivals are a place of fun and happiness! 
The food is amazing 
because you get to 
share it with the people you care about 
most!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... I hope my mom's doing okay...
choice_data_list: You want to see them, right?
You want to see them, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah... It's hard not to during times 
like these.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But those feelings of loneliness and 
sadness no longer get to me 
because...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I love it here! I love spending every day 
here at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm a regular at a ramen shop, I've found 
new places I love visiting, 
and I've made so 
many close friends!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's probably why the sponge cake 
tasted so good too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It took a lot of courage for me to step out 
of my comfort zone and 
come to the 
academy, but I'm really glad I did—I was 
able to find an 
amazing trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I'll do my part and try my best to 
train hard tomorrow too! 
Now that I've 
filled my stomach, all I need to do is get a 
good night's 
rest, and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what time is it now?! We have to get 
back before they lock us 
out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
B-but you aren't done with your shaved ice 
yet! I want you to take 
your time eating 
such a delicacy...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maybe if I help you finish the dessert—no, 
what am I even saying?! 
That just makes it 
look like I want some of your food!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? R-really? Are you sure? ...Yaaaay! 
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All right, then... I'm digging in! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmm! The ice is so crunchy... and 
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The milk... tastes just like the milk... I had 
back in 
Hokkaido—Hawaaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
O-owww... My head... It hurts... Brain... is 
freezing...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Self-inflicted though the pain may have 
been, I lend my shoulder to 
the ailing 
Special Week and we somehow manage to 
make it back in 
time.
